spec.kitLine: S1-a: start of battle, Shield 21.12% MaxHP
spec.assertion: A passive/self block carrying a shield effect at maxHpPct 21.12 with NO durationSec. Proves the status is up from frame 0 and continuous — which is what makes every 'not in Nano Coating' branch permanently inert at scope lock. Fails under the nearest-wrong keyings (interval/burstCast, or a durationSec that lets the status lapse).

spec.kitLine: S1-b: burst re-shield if NOT in status
spec.assertion: it.skip — the schema has requiresShielded (only WHILE shielded) but no negative counterpart, and shield applications are not emitted on cfg.onEvent. Moot regardless: the v1 boss deals no damage so S1-a's shield never breaks, so this branch can never fire.

A hitCount{count:200}/self block carrying a shield effect at maxHpPct 2.85. Proves the trigger is a ROUND count (hitsPerShot 1, so 200 rounds = 200 pulls), not an invented interval; fails under an interval/shotFired+everyN encoding or a wrong count. The 'while in Nano Coating' gate is a no-op at scope (shield permanent) so requiresShielded is not required.
it.skip — StatKey has no shield-HP stat and no shield HP pool is modelled, so the escalating tier ladder has no representation. Doubly inert: gated on NOT being in Nano Coating.

Two-sided: structurally every skill1/skill2 effect must be kind 'shield' (catches a 'heal' encoding of 'Restores Shield HP', which would fire recovery triggers, and any fudged damage/ATK line); behaviourally, clearing both slots (with burst requiresShielded stripped so a legitimately gated burst is not collateral) leaves totals() byte-identical for the whole team.

Burst-bucket damage count equals the fullBurstStart count (+1 tolerance for an end-of-fight cast) and kilo's total strictly exceeds the burst-cleared counterfactual. Fails if the line is dropped (0 events), keyed to passive/interval/shotFired (count runs past the FB count), or recorded only in unmodeled.

Every burst-bucket damage event has inFullBurst false and fbMajorApplied false, and rangeApplied false. Fails under the nearest-wrong re-key to fullBurstEnter (both FB flags flip true), which would silently add the +50% major to every burst.

Structural: every burst-slot flatDamage effect has core falsy (event-level coreRate 0 as a secondary check). The kit says nothing about core strike damage; core:true on a Defender with coreAttackMultiplier 200 would inflate every burst.

spec.kitLine: B-a basis: ATK from 5% of final MaxHP
spec.assertion: it.skip — flatDamage.atkPct scales off the caster's FINAL ATK; there is no Max-HP-basis damage primitive. Any shipped atkPct is a derived constant (approx 1150.84 x 0.05 x maxHp/staticAtk), frozen at base stats and blind to live Max-HP buffs. Flagged as an ALWAYS-flag magnitude, with the recipe (a maxHpFlat grant should move the hit and an atkPct grant should not — inverted from what the primitive does).

spec.kitLine: B-b: Max HP up 48% for 20 sec
spec.assertion: Behavioural: the HP48 counterfactual injects the branch live, so the maxHpFlat magnitude it emits to kilo (0.48 x her Max HP) is by construction the magnitude a live B-b would emit; that magnitude must be absent from the faithful run's kilo-targeted maxHpFlat applies (teammate HP grants appear in both runs and cancel). Structural companion: no Max-HP stat buff anywhere in the burst slot. Fails under the nearest-wrong literal reading of 'Activates when using Burst Skill' that ships B-b live — the branch requires NOT being in Nano Coating, which never happens at scope lock, and no negative gate exists to express it.

Every block targets self or enemy (the kit says 'Affects self' everywhere except the burst's 'all enemies'); effect kinds restricted to shield/flatDamage/buff; no offensive stat buff from a 32-stat blocklist; hasPierce/hasTrueNormals/modes/resources/consolidation all absent. Kilo's kit carries zero ATK/crit/ammo/reload/fire-rate lines, so any of these is invention.

fixtures: controlComp('kilo', false) — liter (B1) + crown (B2) + kilo (B3), fixed second B3 slot dropped. Four hoisted 180 s runs: BASE; NO_SKILLS (skill1+skill2 cleared, burst requiresShielded stripped so a Nano-Coating-gated burst is not collateral damage of the counterfactual); NO_BURST (burst cleared); HP48 (B-b injected live as a burstCast/self targetMaxHpPct 48 for 20 s). The fixed B3 is dropped on purpose: it makes kilo the SOLE Burst III, so she casts every rotation (a lone B3 would make zero full bursts — B1+B2 are present to chain), every fullBurstStart maps 1:1 to a kilo cast (cast counting without a per-event unit id), kilo is the only source of burst-BUCKET damage in the comp (bucket==='burst' IS kilo attribution), and the fixed B3's own buffs are removed as a confound. Non-vacuity is asserted first: >= 2 full bursts and kilo total damage > 0.
gaps: it.skip 'B-a magnitude: ATK calculated from 5% of final Max HP has no primitive' — flatDamage.atkPct scales off caster FINAL ATK; no Max-HP-basis damage effect exists (stackedNuke.hpPct is a different trigger mechanic). Shipped atkPct must be a flagged derived constant; recipe recorded in the skip body.

it.skip 'S1-b burst re-shield if not in Nano Coating' — no negative-shield gate in the schema (requiresShielded is the positive form only); moot anyway since the v1 boss deals no damage and the continuous shield never breaks; shield applications are not on the cfg.onEvent kind list, so unobservable either way.
it.skip 'S2-b escalating Next Shield HP up 17.75/26.66/35.53%' — StatKey has no shield-magnitude stat and no shield HP pool is modelled; doubly moot (gated on NOT in Nano Coating).
it.skip 'S2-a payload: the 2.85% shield restore amount is unobservable' — no HP pool (immortal boss) and no shield event on cfg.onEvent; only the trigger keying and damage-inertness are assertable.
